build_vision_transformer: build a VisionTransformer model with configurable patch size, depth, and attention type for video classification
create_timesformer_model: create a TimeSformer model with specified image size, num frames, and divided space time attention
build_vit_base_patch16: build a vit_base_patch16_224 model from config with pretrained ImageNet weights and temporal attention
test_attention_module: test the Attention module forward pass with multi-head QKV projection and softmax attention
review_Block_divided_space_time: review the Block class divided_space_time attention that separates temporal and spatial attention paths
